IBM announced that it aims to surpass a 1,000‑qubit count by 2027, deploying its new Nighthawk **r3** processor architecture as the next key milestone in its quantum roadmap. The company plans to iterate on this design through successive generations—Nighthawk r2 and r4—to increase qubit connectivity, coherence time, and error correction capability. This strategy positions IBM to provide larger‑scale, higher‑fidelity quantum machines for advanced scientific and commercial applications within the next decade.
